name: Chess.com Published-Data API
summary: Read-only Chess.com PubAPI: player profiles, ratings and stats, monthly game archives with PGN, leaderboards, titled players, clubs and tournaments.
description: PubAPI re-packages public data from the Chess.com website as JSON-LD style documents: player profiles and stats, monthly game archives (with PGN), daily puzzle, titled-player lists, country, club and tournament data and the streamer list. Responses are cached and refresh at most every 12 hours. No key is needed.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: Requests with an empty or default curl User-Agent returned 403; docs ask for a User-Agent containing contact information.

rate_limit.summary: Serial access is unlimited; parallel requests may get 429. Docs ask for a User-Agent with contact info so abusive clients can be contacted before blocking.

endpoints.summary: Ratings and win/loss records per time control
All games of a month with PGN
Usernames of all players with a title (GM, IM, ...)

license.name: Chess.com Terms of Service; no data license stated

agent_notes: Usernames are lower-case in URLs. Walk /player/{u}/games/archives to list month URLs, then fetch each month. Always set a descriptive User-Agent and fetch serially.
caveats: Default curl User-Agent and empty User-Agent both returned 403 today.
Data is cached for up to 12 hours.

verification.notes: Example executed with the datasets-library User-Agent.
